When to Call for Toile Repair?

When you flush the toilet, does it run for long periods of time? Or, maybe you hear the sound of running water. You’ll need toilet repair service anytime your toilet doesn’t flush and refill properly. Any changes to fill time or difficulty with flushes can indicate a problem with the attached plumbing.

There might be something stuck in your pipes that shouldn’t be there — everything from toys to jewelry occasionally winds up in the bowl and your sewer pipes. You could also have a problem with the toilet tank. Either way, you’ll want a professional plumber to take a look and diagnose the issue.

We offer comprehensive toilet repair services and only recommend replacement when it’s the best or only option for your home. If your toilet isn’t repairable, we’ll recommend a toilet replacement and walk you through all the options for a new bathroom seat.

blocks.text: If your toilet has cracked porcelain or uses too much water to flush clean, then a toilet replacement is definitely in the cards, but you may want to consider updating even functioning units if you have family members with mobility challenges. Deeper knee bends can be an issue for people as they age, making higher toilets a big comfort improvement.
